name: Hypercubes Are Strictly Contained in Learning-Space Graphs
scope: Finite graphs, using irredundant set-family representations where relevant.
statement: Every finite hypercube is a learning-space graph, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: The full powerset is accessible and union closed. The three-set chain representing $P_3$ is also accessible and union closed, but its graph is not a hypercube.
